contexts.text: Proprium vivified by the Lord is called the Lord's bride, and wife. AC 253.

In ancient times... it was customary to give a pendant of gold and bracelets to a bride, because the Church was represented by a bride; its good by the pendant, and its truth by the bracelets. AC 3105. AC 4638:8.

The veil with which a bride covered her face when she first saw the bridegroom = appearances of truth; for with the ancients brides represented affections of truth, and bridegrooms affections of good; or what is the same thing, the Church, which was called a bride from the affection of truth; the affection of good which is from the Lord was the bridegroom; hence the Lord Himself is called the Bridegroom; and the brides veiled their faces on their first approach to the bridegroom in order to represent the appearances of truth. AC 4434:8. AE 223:13.
Under Husband, see this reference, and at AC 10168. CL 117.
The dowry was a token of consent... and to accept it was the reciprocal, thus the bride was the bridegroom's and the bridegroom the bride's.
Under Bridegroom, see these references. AC 7047. AC 9182:5. DP 8:4. AR 797. AR 812:2. AR 960:end. CL 20:2. CL 21. CL 300:end.
Because truth does not appear in its true quality before it is conjoined with its own good... a bride on first seeing her husband covered herself with a veil.
The Church is a bride when she wills to receive the Lord, and a wife when she receives Him.

Prepared as a bride for her husband () = that Church conjoined with the Lord through the Word... By Jerusalem is meant the Church, and John saw it first as a city, and afterwards as a virgin bride, as a city representatively, and as a virgin bride spiritually, thus in a twofold idea, one within or above the other...

The bride, the Lamb's wife = the New Church which will be conjoined with the Lord through the Word. That Church is called a bride when being renewed, and a wife when she has been renewed; here, the bride the wife because she is certainly to be renewed.

The Spirit and the bride say, Come = that Heaven and the Church long for the Lord's Advent... The Church which is here called the bride does not mean the Church from those who are in falsities of faith, but the Church from those who are in truths of faith, for these long for the light, thus for the Advent of the Lord.
Virginity is called the crown of chastity... wherefore a bride wears a crown on her head at her wedding...

This may be likened to a bride, who constantly carries something of the image of the bridegroom in the sight of her spirit, beholds him in his gifts as in mirrors, longs for his coming, and when he comes receives him with joy, in which the love of her bosom exults.
